name: domain-experts
description: OneStudio's domain expert agent toolkit — one plugin, 3 skills: domain-creator, domain-upgrade, domain-chat. Build, upgrade, and chat with domain expert agents in Claude Code.

plugins.name: domain-experts
plugins.description: The toolkit — 3 skills: domain-creator (build a new agent, with context-aware prefill from venture docs and strict domain-widening so the agent is built around the wider category, never the product a PRD describes), domain-upgrade (audit + uplevel an existing agent against the framework's 11 dimensions), domain-chat (browser chat UI via agent-kit). Install this to build or maintain domain expert agents.
